item.title: The week in pictures: Mideast war, a lunar mission and Holy Week processions
item.summary: The war in the Middle East showed no sign of ending as President Donald Trump exchanged threats with the Iranian regime and jittery markets sent oil prices surging. The week also saw NASA launch its first crewed lunar mission in half-a-century, Italy miss out on a third succes...

item.title: Inside the race to rescue a downed US airman in Iran
item.summary: President Donald Trump on Sunday hailed a daring rescue of a downed US airman in central Iran, but Tehran insisted the mission was “foiled”, leaving the world to sift fact from fiction amid conflicting reports and viral images.

item.title: Middle East war live: ‘Open the F***in' Strait’, Trump says, or US will target Iran's infrastructure on Tuesday
Easter in Jerusalem overshadowed by war and restrictions at the Holy Sepulchre
item.summary: Silence reigned on Easter Sunday in the alleyways of Jerusalem's Old City, with the holiday overshadowed by war and restrictions on access to the Holy Sepulchre, where Christians commemorate Christ's crucifixion and resurrection.

item.title: French boats set sail from Marseille to join Gaza aid Flotilla
item.summary: Some 20 French boats set sail from Marseille on Saturday to join up with an international flotilla making a renewed effort to break an Israeli blockade and deliver aid to Gaza.

item.title: "We got him!": US rescues aviator whose fighter jet was shot down in Iran
item.summary: The United States said Sunday it rescued a service member missing behind enemy lines since Iran downed a fighter jet, as President Donald Trump escalated pressure on Tehran with a new looming deadline to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.summary: Seema Gupta is live from Rome.

item.summary: Pope Leo XIV celebrated his first Easter Mass as pontiff with a condemnation of “the violence of war that kills and destroys,’’ amid the US-Israeli war on Iran and Russia’s campaign in Ukraine. In his homily, the pontiff singled out those who wage war, abuse the weak and prior...

item.title: Lebanon: In the city of Tyre, Christians mark Easter in a ghost town
item.summary: Israel's military renewed strikes on the southern Lebanese city of Tyre after issuing evacuation warnings, following attacks on nearby buildings that damaged a hospital.

item.title: Ramstein: Controversy in Germany over military base's role in Middle East war
item.summary: Although Germany insists it is not a party to the war in Iran, the U.S. airbase in Ramstein plays a key role in coordinating American military operations causing controversy.
